The native BrowserWindow integration adapts the MIT-licensed Mori implementation from
https://github.com/FujiwaraChoki/mori-browser at commit
`b5b29c2e29061f9b2009e8cc0b2756c6ad62bb20`. The retained license is
[Mori-LICENSE](Mori-LICENSE). Crest changes replace shared-window ownership with
explicit native window assignments and connect commands to the portable core.
